manifest.name: deepseek-harness-game-studios
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness Game Studios (DSGS)——Claude-Code-Game-Studios @b21fa0f (MIT) 的 DSH 移植，一站式装入：钩子桥（上游 9 个事件全覆盖）、状态行、以及自带框架载荷的机器级安装（装入后任意空文件夹打 /start 即可初始化）。已实现 74 技能 + 49 代理 + 13 规则 + 14 Node 钩子，内容零丢失；未实现：GUI 停靠状态条（前端清单只收官方包）与 PreToolUse 事前提醒（DSH 无上下文章通道），替代方案见仓库 README。
manifest.author: HYClub

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch for the merged DSGS package.
#
# Two rows, both naming subpath exports of this package, so one install brings the hook bridge and
# the status-line projection together. Configs are empty on purpose:
#   - dsgs-hooks finds <project>/.dsh/hooks.json by walking up from the launch directory,
#   - dsgs-statusline registers its projection and does no I/O at all.
- insert:
    - id: dsgs-hooks
      name: "deepseek-harness-game-studios/hooks"
      config: {}
    - id: dsgs-statusline
      name: "deepseek-harness-game-studios/statusline"
      config: {}

readme.text:
[](README.md) [](README.zh-CN.md)

[Install](#install) · [Implementation status](#implementation-status) · [Project structure](#project-structure) · [Testing your customizations](#testing-your-own-customizations) · [Verification](#verification) · [License](#license)

Turn a single DeepSeek Harness session into a full game development studio.
**49 agents. 79 skills. One coordinated AI team.**

This is a **port of [Claude Code Game Studios](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios) (CCGS)**
to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — not a rewrite from scratch: the skills, agents, rules and docs come from
upstream (MIT); this repository provides the DSH-native runtime (Node hooks, skill generation,
machine-level install, plugin bridge).

| | |
|---|---|
| Upstream project | [`Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios`](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios) |
| Upstream version this port tracks | **v1.1.2** (commit `b21fa0f`, 2026-09-29) |
| Upstream license | **MIT** (Copyright © 2026 Donchitos) — reused here |
| This repository | `deepseek-harness-game-studios` (DSGS) **v0.2.2** |
| Port strategy | Dual stack, one source: `.claude/` is the content source (upstream text, kept verbatim); `.dsh/**` is generated by `tools/build-dsh.mjs` |

Upstream targets Claude Code (`.claude/`, `.sh` hooks, `bash` one-liners, `@path` imports). None of that
runs under DSH (no `bash` tool, piped child processes are denied by the sandbox, `@path` is not expanded),
so instead of editing upstream content we generate a DSH-runnable equivalent and prove **no content loss**.

> The plugin package bundles the framework under `payload/` — you never need to look at it while using the plugin.

`Plugins` → `Add plugin` → paste `https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios` → **Install** → restart `dsh web`.

```pwsh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios
```

Open the desktop app, then `Plugins` → `Add plugin` → paste the same URL → **Install** → restart the app.

On first load the plugin installs the framework at machine level (`~/.dsh/dsgs` plus user-level
bootstrap skills). After that:

```
new working directory → new session → type /start
```

`/start` checks whether the workspace is initialised; if not it initialises it first, then walks you
through onboarding.

Run `/update` inside an initialised workspace (0.2.1 and later):

```
/update
```

It reads the installed version and the newest release, shows the commands it will run, and runs them only after
you agree. Restart the client afterwards — the new skills appear in a new session.

**Is this workspace initialised?** Yes when `.dsh/skills/start/SKILL.md` or `.dsgs-installed.json` exists in the
project root. If neither is there, open the project in DSH, start a new session and type `/start`: that
initialises it once, and every later session in the same project can use `/update`.

**Coming from 0.2.0 or earlier?** `/update` only exists from 0.2.1 on, so the first update is manual:

```pwsh
dsh plugin --profile web remove deepseek-harness-game-studios
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios
```

Desktop app users do the same through `Plugins` (see below). Every update after that is one `/update`.

**Desktop app** — the app owns its plugin profile, so the command line cannot change it. Open `Plugins`, uninstall
`deepseek-harness-game-studios`, choose `Add plugin`, paste
`https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios`, install, then restart the app. `/update` still reports
the version and tells you when this is needed.

readme.section: What the plugin writes to your machine (and how to undo it)
readme.text:
| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `~/.dsh/dsgs/**` | framework payload (skills, agents, rules, hooks, tools, docs, instruction files) |
| `~/.dsh/skills/dsgs-init/SKILL.md`, `~/.dsh/skills/start/SKILL.md` | user-level bootstrap skills |

It never touches a project directory and never overwrites project files. To undo:

```pwsh
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsgs"
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\dsgs-init","$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\start"

readme.section: ⚠️ Partly equivalent — works, with a stated limit
readme.text:
| Item | What works | What does not, and why |
|---|---|---|
| 3 hook events | mapping implemented and unit-tested | `Notification`, `PreCompact`, `PostCompact` have no DSH event source, so they are verified at mount level only (live coverage 6/9) |
| Per-agent tool allowlists | every role card **states** the boundary in its body (`工具边界 …：read, glob, grep, …`), so a delegating model reads it | DSH's `subagent` accepts no per-agent tool set and there is no agent registry, so the runtime cannot enforce it |
| Byte-for-byte bash ↔ Node parity | every pair that can run matches byte for byte; the two YAML-dependent pairs are **counted and asserted** (an unexpected skip fails the run; `PARITY_REQUIRE_ALL=1` forbids skipping where `python3` exists) | `python3` in this machine's Git Bash is a Store placeholder, so the bash side of those two pairs cannot read YAML |

| Item | Why | Substitute |
|---|---|---|
| Docked status bar above the composer | DSH's client roster only lists `@deepseek-ai/*` packages (measured: 60+ entries, ours absent even with a `dsh.client` declaration) | `/statusline` skill + `node .dsh/statusline.mjs`; the runtime half (turns/tokens/cache/context %) is already covered by DSH's own status bar |
| Pre-action reminders on PreToolUse | `tools/pre-execute` only carries `allow/deny/cancel/ask`; `additionalContexts` is read from the final tool result; `agent.inject()` mid-execution has no effect | `validate-commit` / `validate-push` are also registered on **PostToolUse** (reminder arrives after the action); set the plugin row `advisory: deny` to block before the action |
| `!`cmd`` pre-execution lines | DSH has no pre-execution | rewritten as a "prerequisite command" block the model runs itself |

```
.claude/                     # Upstream content source (MIT, kept verbatim)
  settings.json              # Hooks, permissions, safety rules
  agents/                    # 49 agent definitions
  skills/                    # 74 skills (one directory per skill)

DSGS is a template you are meant to edit. `DSGS Skill Testing Framework/` is how you check that an
edited or newly written skill still holds up — a catalog of all skills and agents, per-category quality
rubrics, behavioral specs, and templates for writing specs of your own.

```
/skill-test static [name]     # structural linter
/skill-test category [name]   # category-specific quality rubric
/skill-test spec [name]       # behavioral spec assertions
/skill-test audit             # coverage report across skills and agents

It tests the *framework*, never your game — game tests live in `tests/`.

```pwsh
pwsh -File tools/verify-port.ps1        # 7 steps: generate → structure → refs → fidelity → hooks → mount → suites
node tools/check-dsh.mjs                # skills=79 agents=49 rules=13 hooks=14 errors=0 warnings=0
node tools/verify-fidelity.mjs          # unexplained 0 / no content loss (258 files, 42,895 lines)
node tools/verify-hooks-mount.mjs       # 10/10 mount cases

DSGS is a port; the original work — 74 skills, 49 agents, 13 rules and all the documentation — was
written by the **upstream author**, and their own support links live in the
[upstream repository](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios). If this project saves you
time, please support **them** first. Issues and contributions about the DSH port itself belong in this
repository.

MIT License — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Upstream copyright © 2026 Donchitos; the port layer (generator,
Node hooks, plugin, installers, DSGS-only skills) is released under the same license.

[](README.md) [](README.zh-CN.md)

[安装](#安装) · [实现状态](#实现状态) · [项目结构](#项目结构) · [测试你的定制](#测试你自己的定制) · [验证](#验证) · [许可证](#许可证)

把一次 DeepSeek Harness 会话变成一间完整的游戏工作室。
**49 个代理。79 个技能。一支协调好的 AI 团队。**

本仓库是 [Claude Code Game Studios](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios)（CCGS）
到 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**移植**，不是从零自研：技能、代理、规则、文档都来自上游（MIT）；
本仓库提供 DSH 原生运行时（Node 钩子、技能生成、机器级安装、插件桥）。

| | |
|---|---|
| 上游项目 | [`Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios`](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios) |
| 本移植锁定的上游版本 | **v1.1.2**（commit `b21fa0f`，2026-09-29） |
| 上游许可证 | **MIT**（Copyright © 2026 Donchitos），本仓库沿用 |
| 本仓库 | `deepseek-harness-game-studios`（DSGS）**v0.2.2** |
| 移植方式 | 双栈同源：`.claude/` 是内容源（上游原文，逐字保留）；`.dsh/**` 由 `tools/build-dsh.mjs` 生成 |

上游面向 Claude Code（`.claude/`、`.sh` 钩子、`bash` 一行流、`@path` 导入）。这些在 DSH 下**无法直接运行**
（没有 `bash` 工具、管道捕获子进程被沙箱拒绝、不展开 `@path`）。本项目**不改上游内容**，而是生成
DSH 可运行的等价物，并验证**内容零丢失**。

> 插件包把框架打包在 `payload/` 下 —— 使用插件时你不需要看它。

`插件` → `添加插件` → 填 `https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios` → **安装** → 重启 `dsh web`。

```pwsh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios
```

打开桌面客户端，`插件` → `添加插件` → 填同一个 URL → **安装** → 重启客户端。

插件首次加载时会自动把框架装到机器级（`~/.dsh/dsgs` 与用户级引导技能）。之后：

```
新建工作区 → 新会话 → 打 /start
```

`/start` 会自己判断该工作区有没有初始化：没有就先初始化，然后带你走引导。

在**初始化过的工作区**里输入（0.2.1 及以上版本才有 `/update`）：

```
/update
```

它会读出已安装版本与最新版本，把要执行的命令先给你看，**你同意之后**才执行。装完重启客户端，新技能在**新会话**里出现。

**这个工作区初始化了吗？** 项目根目录下有 `.dsh/skills/start/SKILL.md` 或 `.dsgs-installed.json` 就算初始化过。
两个都没有的话：在 DSH 里打开这个项目，新开一个会话打 `/start` —— 初始化一次即可，以后在这个项目里随时可以 `/update`。

**从 0.2.0 或更早版本过来？** `/update` 从 0.2.1 才有，所以第一次升级要手动：

```pwsh
dsh plugin --profile web remove deepseek-harness-game-studios
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios
```

桌面版用户走 `插件` 面板（见下）。之后每次升级都是一条 `/update`。

**桌面版**：插件 profile 由应用独占，命令行改不了它。打开 `插件` → 卸载 `deepseek-harness-game-studios` →
`添加插件` 粘贴 `https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios` → 安装 → 重启。
`/update` 照样会帮你查版本，并告诉什么时候需要这么做。

readme.section: 插件会往你机器上写什么（与撤销）
readme.text:
| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `~/.dsh/dsgs/**` | 框架载荷（技能、代理、规则、钩子、工具、文档、指令文件） |
| `~/.dsh/skills/dsgs-init/SKILL.md`、`~/.dsh/skills/start/SKILL.md` | 用户级引导技能 |

它**绝不触碰任何项目目录**，也**绝不覆盖项目里的文件**。撤销：

```pwsh
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsgs"
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\dsgs-init","$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\start"

readme.section: 再卸载插件并重启 dsh web

readme.text:
| 项 | 状态 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 技能 | ✅ | 上游 74 个全部移植，逐个可 `/调用` |
| 代理角色卡 | ✅ | 49 个，`.dsh/agents/<name>.md` + 委派约定 |
| 规则 | ✅ | 13 条，含上游"路径作用域规则引擎"的等价替代：PostToolUse 钩子在每次写入/编辑后注入命中的规则原文 |
| 钩子 | ✅ | 上游 12 个脚本 → 14 个 Node 重写版，经 `dsh-hooks-claude-code` 桥接；9 个上游事件全覆盖 |
| 钩子真实执行 | ✅ | 挂载 10/10 · 协议 12/12 · 事件活体 6/9 —— 在装有官方 bridge 包的机器上测得；没有该包的环境会报 SKIP，而不是假失败 |
| 配置解析 | ✅ | `project.yaml` 单一来源；`resolve_config` / `__call resolve_setting` 的 Node 端口 |
| 辅助脚本 | ✅ | 上游每个 `.sh` 都有 Node 端口（`.dsh/scripts/*.mjs`），沙箱内可运行 |
| 内容保真 | ✅ | 258 文件 / 42,895 行：96.0% 逐字、3.1% 已记录改写、0.5% 结构性、0.4% 换写法、**0 行无法解释的丢失** |
| 机器级安装 | ✅ | 插件自带载荷（924 个文件）并在首次加载时安装；空工作区打 `/start` 即可用它初始化 |
| `/statusline` | ✅ | 工作室状态行 `阶段 · 姿态 · epic > story · Sprint n/m · 引擎`（+13 单测） |
| 嵌套委派 | ✅ | `subagent.maxDepth: 2` 实测「父 → 子 → 孙」（DSH 默认 1） |
| 共享规则真正到达项目 | ✅ | `CLAUDE.md` 里的 `@path` 导入被改写成「需要时读某个文件」——本运行时**不展开** `@`，不这么做的话那些标准文档只是被引用、从未被读 |
| 角色工具边界 | ✅ | 每张代理角色卡写明"本角色应只用哪些工具"，并统一成本运行时的工具名。**属软约束**：运行时无法按代理限定工具集 |
| 一键式插件 | ✅ | 一个包 = 钩子桥 + 状态行投影 + 载荷自装 |
| DSGS 专有技能 | ✅ | `statusline`、`dsgs-install`（上游没有） |

readme.section: ⚠️ 部分等价 —— 能用，但有一处明确的限制
readme.text:
| 项 | 能用的部分 | 限制与原因 |
|---|---|---|
| 3 个钩子事件 | 映射已实现并单测 | `Notification`、`PreCompact`、`PostCompact` 在 DSH 没有事件源，只能到挂载级验证（活体 6/9） |
| 逐代理工具白名单 | **每张角色卡正文写明边界**（`工具边界 …：read, glob, grep, …`），委派时模型读得到 | DSH 的 `subagent` 不接受按代理限定工具集，也没有代理注册中心，运行时无法强制 |
| bash ↔ Node 逐字节对照 | 能跑的每一对都逐字节一致；依赖 YAML 的 2 对是**受控断言**（数量不符即失败；有 `python3` 的环境用 `PARITY_REQUIRE_ALL=1` 禁止 SKIP） | 本机 Git Bash 的 `python3` 是 Store 占位程序，bash 侧读不了 YAML |

readme.section: ❌ 无法等价 —— 原因与替代
readme.text:
| 项 | 原因 | 替代 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入框上方的停靠状态条 | DSH 的前端插件清单只收 `@deepseek-ai/*`（实测 60+ 条全为官方包，本包即使补 `dsh.client` 声明仍不在其中） | `/statusline` 技能 + `node .dsh/statusline.mjs`；运行时字段（轮次/token/缓存/上下文%）由 DSH 自带状态条覆盖 |
| PreToolUse 的事前提醒 | `tools/pre-execute` 只携带 `allow/deny/cancel/ask`；`additionalContexts` 只从工具最终结果读取；执行中 `agent.inject()` 无效 | `validate-commit` / `validate-push` 同时注册在 **PostToolUse**（提醒在动作之后到达）；要事前阻断可把插件行设为 `advisory: deny` |
| `!`cmd`` 预执行行 | DSH 没有预执行 | 改写为「前置命令」块，由模型自己运行 |

```
.claude/                     # 上游内容源（MIT，逐字保留）
  settings.json              # 钩子、权限、安全规则
  agents/                    # 49 个代理定义
  skills/                    # 74 个技能（每技能一个目录）

DSGS 是给你改的模板。`DSGS Skill Testing Framework/` 用来验证改过或新写的技能是否还站得住：
全部技能与代理的目录、按类别的质量评分表、行为规格，以及写规格用的模板。

```
/skill-test static [name]     # 结构 linter
/skill-test category [name]   # 按类别的质量评分
/skill-test spec [name]       # 行为规格断言
/skill-test audit             # 技能与代理的覆盖报告

它测的是**框架**，永远不是你的游戏 —— 游戏的测试放在 `tests/`。

```pwsh
pwsh -File tools/verify-port.ps1        # 7 步：生成 → 结构 → 引用 → 保真 → 钩子 → 挂载 → 套件
node tools/check-dsh.mjs                # skills=79 agents=49 rules=13 hooks=14 errors=0 warnings=0
node tools/verify-fidelity.mjs          # unexplained 0 / 内容零丢失（258 文件，42,895 行）
node tools/verify-hooks-mount.mjs       # 10/10 挂载用例

DSGS 是移植：原始工作 —— 74 个技能、49 个代理、13 条规则与全部文档 —— 由**上游作者**完成，
他本人的支持渠道在[上游仓库](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios)。
如果这个项目帮你省了时间，请**优先支持上游作者**。与 DSH 移植本身相关的 issue 与贡献请提到本仓库。

MIT License —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。上游版权 © 2026 Donchitos；移植层（生成器、Node 钩子、插件、
安装器、DSGS 专有技能）以同一许可证发布。
